title: ISW Void Sign-Flip Observational Pipeline: From EFC Theory to Data Confrontation
abstract: Complete 6-stage data pipeline for testing the EFC void ISW sign-flip prediction. Uses DESIVAST DR1 void catalogs and Planck PR4 CMB maps. Tests three frozen predictions: sign-flip at delta_c ~ -0.8, scale amplification at R_v > 100 h^-1 Mpc, and stronger signal at z < 0.5. Includes RCMB compliance layer with 4 diagnostic tests. Kill criterion: no sign-flip at any void depth falsifies EFC void sector.
